sentences.text: Hello, everyone. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. I am Emily, your host.
Today, we visit Karaman, a historic city in Iran. Karaman is in the southeast of the country.
It is famous for its desert, old buildings, and kind people.
Let's explore Karaman together. Part 2. Where is Karaman?
Karaman is close to the look desert, one of the hottest places on earth.
The city is surrounded by mountains and dry lands.
It is far from Tehran and big cities, so life is calm.
Karaman is large in area, but not crowded. Part 3. History of Karaman.
Karaman has a very long history. It is more than 2000 years old.
Many kings, traitors, and travelers visited Karaman in the past.
The city was important on the Silk Road, the old trade route.
Karaman is full of old mosques, baths, and markets from ancient times.
Hatter part 4. The desert near Karaman. The most famous place near Karaman is the loot desert.
The desert has tall sand formations called calutes. They look like castles made by nature.
In summer, the desert becomes extremely hot. In winter, it is cooler and calm. Tourists come to see the sunset and stars.
Part 5. The City of Karaman.
Karaman City has wide streets, parks, and old neighborhoods.
There is a famous market called Grand Bazaar of Karaman.
People sell carpets, spices, copper products, and sweets.
Life in Karaman is relaxed. People enjoy tea houses, small shops, and quiet evenings.
Part 6. Food in Karaman. Karaman has delicious traditional food.
A famous dish is Bosgorm, a lamb stew with special herbs.
Another dish is Dopiasse, made with potatoes and onions.
People also love pistachios, because Karaman has many pistachio farms.
Tea is very important, and people drink it many times a day.
Part 7. People of Karaman.
People in Karaman are friendly and hospitable. They speak Persian farci.
Most people also know simple English words. Families are close, and respect for elders is very important.
People love poetry, music, and nature.
Part 8. Culture and Crafts.
Karaman is famous for carpets. Karaman carpets are colorful, soft, and world famous.
People also make copper handicrafts, traditional clothes, and wooden art.
Cultural life includes poetry nights and small music gatherings.
Part 9. Important Places in Karaman. Karaman has many beautiful places.
Gangjali Khan Complex, an old bath, mosque, and bazaar.
Jabali Dome, a mysterious stone building. Shada Desert, home of the famous sand formations.
Ran Castle, an ancient mud brick castle.
These places show the long history of the city.
Part 10. Weather in Karaman. Karaman has hot summers and cold winters.
In spring, the weather is soft and nice.
In autumn, the city is cool and colorful. Many people visit in spring and autumn.
Part 11. Daily Life. Daily Life in Karaman is simple.
People wake up early, work in shops, farms, or offices.
In the evening, families drink tea together. Children play in parks.
Markets stay open until late. Life is peaceful and slow.
Part 12. Why Karaman is special?
Karaman is special because it has.
Ancient history, beautiful desert, kind people, delicious food, colorful art, and carpets.
